ev_0006.summary: Semicircle figure with diameter MN on y=301 (N at (522.8,301); M is the unmatched label_04 at the left end, snapped to the arc's left endpoint (52,301)). Center O (287.3,300.9) lies on the diameter, and the radius OP (vertical, x=287, P at top (287,64.9)) is perpendicular to MN at O. A lies on OP at (287,195.2). B (480.4,166.3) lies on the arc. Segments O-B and A-B are two distinct lines meeting at B; both are straight and terminate on the arc. The supervisor's claim of a perpendicular at A is not supported: AB slopes about -0.15, so it is not perpendicular to vertical OP, and no right-angle mark was verified at A.
